# TryHackMe

> > TryHackMe is an online cybersecurity training platform offering hands-on learning through virtual machines, custom learning paths, and gamified skill development.

TryHackMe provides role-based cybersecurity training with customizable content paths, user group management, and assignment features for teams and individuals. The platform includes a loyalty program with streak rewards and a merchandise store operated by BigFawn.

## Key Topics

- Cybersecurity Training
- Role-Based Learning
- Custom Learning Paths
- Virtual Machines
- User Groups & Assignments
- Content Customization
- Training Segmentation
- Streak Rewards
- 45-Day Streak Program
- TryHackMe Store
- Swag & Merchandise
- Discount Codes
- Loyalty Program
- Hands-On Labs

## Learning & Training Management

- [Skill | role-based learning, segmenting training](https://help.tryhackme.com/en/articles/8484470-skill-role-based-learning-segmenting-training): TryHackMe role-based learning with custom paths and targeted assignments

## Rewards & Merchandise

- [45-day Streak 5% Off Swag](https://help.tryhackme.com/en/articles/8831940-45-day-streak-5-off-swag): Earn 5% discount on TryHackMe swag with 45-day streak reward
